r.name: Broadheath - Hallow Cycle Leisure Route
r.description: Starting at Worcester University and heading out to Broardheath and Hallow. A 14 mile circular route with alternatives to shorten it to 7.5 miles. The route covers a mixture of quiet lanes and bridleways.

r.name: Crowle - Tibberton Cycle Leisure Route
r.description: Starting at Worcester Woods Countryside Centre and heading out to Kempsey. A 12 mile route with alternatives to shorten it to 8 miles. The route covers a mixture of quiet lanes and bridleways.

r.name: Worcester City Circular Cycle Leisure Route
r.description: Circular Worcester City route that can be joined at any point and covers a mixture of quiet lanes, towpaths and cycleways.

r.name: Northwick - Ladywood Cycle Leisure Route
r.description: Circular route starting at the Pump House Environment Centre and covering a mixture of quiet lanes and residential streets.The route is 10.5 miles with a short cut that reduces it to 6.5 miles.

r.name: Shakespeare's Avon Way
r.description: From the source at Naseby, Northamptonshire to the Severn at Tewkesbury

r.name: Millennium Way (Warks)
r.description: A 100 mile long distance footpath, across the centre of England from Pershore to Chipping Warden via Meriden.

r.name: Wychavon Way (old)
r.description: A route from Holt Fleet on the River Severn to Winchcombe in the Cotswolds.

r.name: Eckington Wharf Circular Walk
r.description: A 3.5 mile, waymarked riverside walk in the Worcestershire countryside

r.description: The Winchcombe Way is a 42-mile figure-of-eight trail centred on Winchcombe

r.description: A route from Holt Fleet on the River Severn to Winchcombe in the Cotswolds.

r.name: Three Choirs Way (Hereford to Worcester)
r.description: A route between Gloucester, Hereford and Worcester with a theme linked to the music festival celebrated annually in the three Cathedrals.

National Cycle Network link route to NCN 45

r.description: A route between Gloucester, Hereford and Worcester with a theme linked to the music festival celebrated annually in the three Cathedrals.

r.name: Wyche Way
r.description: A trail linking the Offa's Dyke Path at Kington to the Cotswold Way above Broadway, via the Wyche Cutting on the Malvern Hills.

r.name: Accessible Walk in Croome's Pleasure Grounds, Croome
r.description: Circular route through the historic pleasure grounds, along gravel paths, mostly flat, with one down slope and one up slope, and gates and bridges.

r.name: Conservation Walk, Croome
r.description: This circular walk highlights the conservation work that has been done to look after the parkland. Along gravel paths and open fields with some uneven ground. Mostly flat with gates, bridges and stiles. Ground will be muddy in wet weather.

r.name: Park Seat Circular Walk, Croome
r.description: This circular walk will guide you around the 'Capability' Brown landscape at Croome in Worcestershire. Along gravel paths and open fields with some uneven ground. Mostly flat with a small set of steps, and one steep slope.

r.name: Spring Walk, Croome
r.description: Circular walk around the outer parkland offers great spots to enjoy Croome's springtime flora and fauna. Along gravel paths and open fields with some uneven ground. Mostly flat, including gates, bridges and stiles. Ground will be muddy in wet weather.

r.name: Local Cycle Route 3
r.description: A long route curved around the periphery of worcester. Connects with National cycle routes 46 and 45 in both the Northern and Southern ends.
